body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: That enemy would trigger your unspent Contingency. Response (unopposed): Retarget its effect to another legal target within 1 unit of the original, or delay it until the end of that enemy's current Action.

surges.html: Move 1 unit as you make the adjustment.
After the Contingency resolves, one enemy it affected becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.
